name: Wat Arun
description: Temple of Dawn, one of Bangkok's most iconic riverside landmarks.

name: Wat Pho
description: Famous temple known for the Reclining Buddha.

name: Grand Palace
description: A historic royal complex and one of Bangkok's best-known cultural landmarks.

name: ICONSIAM
description: A riverside shopping, dining, and lifestyle destination on the Chao Phraya River.

name: Siam Paragon
description: A major Bangkok shopping complex at Siam with dining, luxury retail, cinema, and family attractions.

name: CentralWorld
description: One of the largest shopping complexes in Bangkok.

name: MBK Center
description: Large shopping mall well known for affordable goods and electronics.

name: Chatuchak Market
description: One of Bangkok's largest weekend markets, known for local shops, food, fashion, plants, and souvenirs.

name: Asiatique
description: A riverfront night market and entertainment area with restaurants, shops, and evening views.

name: Terminal 21
description: An airport-themed shopping mall where each floor represents a different world city.

name: SEA LIFE Bangkok
description: A large aquarium located beneath the Siam Paragon shopping mall.

name: Mahanakhon SkyWalk
description: Thailand's highest observation deck offering 360-degree panoramic views.

name: Yaowarat
description: Bangkok's bustling Chinatown, famous for its street food and gold shops.

name: Khao San Road
description: A famous street known as a backpacker hub with vibrant nightlife and street food.

name: Lumpini Park
description: A large public park in central Bangkok offering an oasis of green space.

name: Benjakitti Park
description: A large park with a lake and an extensive network of elevated walkways.

name: Erawan Shrine
description: A popular Hindu shrine housing a statue of Phra Phrom, the Thai representation of Brahma.

name: Jim Thompson House
description: A museum housing the art collection of American businessman and architect Jim Thompson.

name: Talad Noi
description: A historic neighborhood known for its street art, traditional architecture, and cafes.

name: Jodd Fairs
description: A popular, lively night market featuring food stalls, drinks, and vintage shops.
